name: @mikeargento/bitgraph-sdk
description: The BitGraph SDK: record files (one file fused solo, many as one set under one position), check and fetch proofs, open a position before the work exists and seal the task under it, verify proofs and BitGraphed files fully offline. One engine, three sockets: this library for TypeScript, the bitgraph CLI (every command speaks --json) for any language that can spawn a process, and bitgraph serve for a localhost API any runtime can call. Files are read locally and never uploaded; only digests, committed artifacts and slot records leave the machine.
